methodology.text: The validation score was derived by cross-referencing industry-standard workflow requirements against the absence of verified buyer intent, ensuring that identified pain points are weighted against the actual market readiness to adopt new software.

executive_summary.text: While there is clear demand for structured approval workflows to replace inefficient email-based processes, the current market evidence lacks indicators of high purchase urgency or a willingness to pay for a new solution.

Agencies struggle with version control and audit trails, yet the lack of direct commitment signals suggests that existing tools or manual workarounds are currently sufficient to manage these operational bottlenecks.
